teaser: Sixteen notes stuck in a browser with no passkey led to a request: let any browser send to my vault, by link, text or QR code.
core_idea: Notes and reads that only existed in a browser without my passkeys showed the nudge working for the right reason, and point to a lane any browser can write to and none can read, offered as a URL, text or QR code; identity is still messy enough to block adoption, users accept one-off friction for clear value, agent email is harder than the service underneath, and the wires show how a general pipeline makes the next product nearly free.

nodes.label: Sixteen changes, one browser
nodes.summary: On an iPhone, a browser that could not reach my passkeys held sixteen changes my vault did not have.

nodes.label: In-app web views
nodes.summary: Apps on iOS cannot use passkeys outside their associated domains; real browsers can.

nodes.label: A nudge for the right reason
nodes.summary: The count shows what is yours and at risk, so the reason to act is real.

nodes.label: Send to my vault
nodes.summary: An append lane on every reader vault that any browser can write to and none can read.

nodes.label: URL, text, QR code
nodes.summary: The lane address, the append token and the public key, and nothing else.

nodes.label: The meter's reading share
nodes.summary: Already encrypts in the browser and appends to sgit.ai's inbox with no vault or passkey.

nodes.label: The six-step brief
nodes.summary: Reader key pair, lane, link, sender, drain and tests; only the key pair and the link are new.

nodes.label: Identity is a mess
nodes.summary: It works on some browsers and paths and not others, and that is why good ideas are not adopted.

nodes.label: One-off friction for value
nodes.summary: WhatsApp's QR pairing and Midjourney's Discord bot: accepted once when the value is clear; worth an A/B test.

nodes.label: Agent email is harder than Gmail
nodes.summary: Attachments, clean thread replies and inline images are the connector's limits, not the API's.

nodes.label: Friction pushes to workarounds
nodes.summary: Blocking a feature for security sends people to other tools, a bigger risk.

nodes.label: Two config files, a product line
nodes.summary: The OWASP and AWS wires run on the Industry Wire's pipeline from two 17-line configs.

nodes.label: Build the general thing once
nodes.summary: The next use of a general mechanism is nearly free: the lane and the wire alike.

quotes.text: That is a nudge for the right reason, and it is working, on me.
quotes.why: Why the count on the vault button is not gamification.

quotes.text: In real use they are the difference between a workflow and a workaround.
quotes.why: The cost of small connector limits.
